title: Job Loved Heavenly Father
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler whose warm heart overflows with thanks, and tonight Job loves Heavenly Father and thanks Him every day: Willow looks around the dinner table and thanks Heavenly Father for her family and her food.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because her heart is full of love and gratitude. In Willow’s world today: at dinner, Willow looked around the table at her family and felt so happy. She said, “Thank you, Heavenly Father, for my family and my food.” Just like Job thanked Heavenly Father every day for his blessings, Willow filled her heart with thankfulness for the people she loves.
